intro: The Netherlands gave the world Rembrandt, Vermeer and Van Gogh, Miffy and some of the best-known DJs on Earth, along with cheese, stroopwafels and windmills.

chapters.title: Painters
text: Rembrandt's Night Watch hangs in Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum, and Vermeer painted Girl with a Pearl Earring. Vincent van Gogh, Piet Mondrian, with his grids of primary colours, and M. C. Escher, famous for impossible staircases, were also Dutch.
Amsterdam's canal ring and the windmills of Kinderdijk are World Heritage Sites.

chapters.title: Food and festivals
text: Gouda and Edam cheeses, stroopwafels (syrup waffles), poffertjes (tiny pancakes), raw herring and hagelslag, chocolate sprinkles on buttered bread, are Dutch favourites.
Sinterklaas brings presents on 5 December. Dutch DJs such as Tiësto, Armin van Buuren and Martin Garrix are global stars, and Dick Bruna created the rabbit Miffy.

keyTerms.meaning: Two thin waffles with caramel syrup between them.
